title: The Canton Hospital

source: Kerr’s 1880 Canton map and the named OpenStreetMap hospital site

mappedIdentity.name: The Canton Hospital
mappedIdentity.address: Historic Boji Hospital site, present North Campus at 107 Yanjiang West Road, Guangzhou, China

features.role: Approximate footprint of the photographed historic building, within the mapped successor hospital campus.

identityStatus: Mapped riverfront premises identify the site. Local placement and geographic heading are estimated inside the successor campus, using the current historic lane alignment and the nineteenth-century location. The 1895 photo fixes the visible building form and controls proportions.

terrainContact.basis: Unmodified Copernicus DSM sampling beside the estimated historic courtyard, preserved for placement review.

notes: The published 1895 photograph supports the exterior arcade, upper covered veranda, balustrade, tiled eaves and masonry details. Rear and side elevations continue the same building vocabulary where the image does not show them.
